title: Identification of proximal interactome of BioID2-tagged mitochondrial Top3α
projectDescription: To interrogate the role of Top3a in mtDNA replication progression, we studied the interaction of mitochondrial Top3a with known mitochondrial DNA maintenance proteins using proximity labelling proteomics. For this experiment, FlpIN-TRex 293 cell line expressing mitochondrial Top3a tagged with BioID2 were used. FlpIN-TRex 293 cell line expressing mitochondria-targeted BioID2 protein served as a control.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Biotinylated proteins from 1 mg isolated mitochondrial proteins were captured on Streptavidin beads. The captured biotinylated proteins from three biological replicates of mtTop3α-BioID2 and MTS-BioID2 experiments were subjected to reduction with 10 mM DTT, alkylation with 30 mM CAA, and on-beads digestion with 1 µg of LysC for 3 hours at room temperature followed by overnight digestion with 1 µg of Trypsin at +37 oC. The resulting peptides were cleaned by Pierce Detergent Removal Spin Columns, desalted with homemade C18 stage-tips, and analyzed by Easy nLC1000 LC system coupled to Q-Exactive hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap. Peptides were separated along a 60 min 5-35% continuous gradient of acetonitrile with 0.1% FA using a 100 μm ID × 15 cm PicoTip electrospray emitter (New Objective) packed with ReproSil-Pur C18-AQ 3 μm 140Å resin (Dr Maisch, GMBH). The mass spectrometer was operated in positive mode and data-dependent acquisition mode using a top10 method. Samples were analyzed in duplicates (technical replicates) using 35% of total sample volume per injection.
dataProcessingProtocol: MaxQuant v.1.6.10.43 software was used to match identified tryptic peptides to the human Uniprot database (ID UP000005640, release date 20210428, including isoforms) and to quantify identified proteins by the label-free quantification (LFQ) method. MaxQuant was set to default settings with minor modifications (enabled ‘Match between runs’, min. peptide length = 6, variable modification = Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term), fixed modification = Carbamidomethyl).
